class.name: GodotDoctorReportPrinter
class.brief_description: Renders CLI validation results to stdout in rich-text format. Walks [GodotDoctorSummaryReport] and its nested report objects, computing pass/fail status and summary statistics inline.

method.name: print_validation_results
method.description: Orchestrates printing of the full validation report from [param validation_suite_reports]. Uses [param stats] (keyed by [enum GodotDoctorSummaryReport.Stat]) to render the summary section without recalculating aggregate totals. Returns [param stats] for downstream consumers.

method.name: _print_report_header
method.description: Prints the decorative report header to stdout.

method.name: _print_suite_reports
method.description: Prints all suites from [param suite_reports].

method.name: _print_scene_report
method.description: Prints a [param scene_report].

method.name: _print_resource_report
method.description: Prints a [param resource_report].

method.name: _print_summary
method.description: Prints a summary of totals across all suites to stdout using the accumulated [param stats].

method.name: _messages_passed
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param messages] contain no effective errors.

method.name: _get_effective_error_count
method.description: Returns the number of messages that count as errors, including warnings promoted to errors when [param treat_warnings_as_errors] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: _get_message_branch
method.description: Returns the branch glyph to use for a message at [param index] in a list of [param count] items.

method.name: _print_messages_tree
method.description: Prints [param messages] as a branch list, selecting the last branch glyph for the final item.

method.name: _print_message_tree
method.description: Prints a single [param msg] using [param branch] as the tree connector character. [param treat_warnings_as_errors] controls whether warnings are displayed as errors.

method.name: _severity_label
method.description: Returns a human-readable severity label for [param msg]. If [param treat_warnings_as_errors] is [code]true[/code], warnings are labelled "WARNING→ERROR".

method.name: _severity_color
method.description: Returns the display [Color] associated with [param label].

method.name: _print_pass_fail_tree_section
method.description: Prints a pass/fail tree section at [param indent_level] with [param heading_label] and a glyph representing [param passed], followed by a tree item with [param tree_text] in [param tree_color].

method.name: _print_warning_mode_if_needed
method.description: Prints an optional warning mode note if [param treat_warnings_as_errors] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: _print_message_section
method.description: Prints a message section with [param heading_label] at [param heading_indent_level] which indicates pass/fail status with [param passed], followed by a tree item with [param tree_text] in [param tree_color], and then a branch list of [param messages] with severity colors determined by [param treat_warnings_as_errors].

method.name: _print_state_heading
method.description: Prints a pass/fail heading line at [param indent_level] with [param label] and an icon representing [param passed].

method.name: _print_tree_item
method.description: Prints a tree item line at [param indent_level] with [param text] and a branch glyph.

method.name: _print_count_line
method.description: Prints an aligned [code]label: count[/code] line at the given indentation level.

method.name: _print_rich_text
method.description: Prints [param text] to stdout using [param color] as the rich-text foreground color.

method.name: _print_summary_tree_line
method.description: Prints a summary tree entry with [param branch] in [constant ReportColors.TOTALS] and [param label] + [param count] right-aligned at [constant _SUMMARY_COLUMN] in [param content_color].

method.name: _indent
method.description: Returns an indentation string repeated [param level] times.

method.name: _get_state_icon
method.description: Returns a checkmark icon if [param passed] is [code]true[/code], or a cross icon if [param passed] is [code]false[/code].

method.name: _get_state_color
method.description: Returns a display color for the pass/fail state represented by [param passed].

method.name: _resolve_uid_path
method.description: Resolves [param path] from a [code]uid://[/code] string to a filesystem path. Returns [param path] unchanged if it is already a filesystem path.

constants.constant: The separator inserted between ancestor node names when rendering a node's path.
Defines the number of spaces to use for each indentation level in the report.
The repeated character used to draw horizontal divider lines in the report.
The number of times [constant _DIVIDER_GLYPH] is repeated to form a full divider line.
Glyph displayed next to a passing validation result.
Glyph displayed next to a failing validation result.
Vertical tree connector used to show that a branch continues below.
Tree connector used for an intermediate branch item.
Tree connector used for the last item in a branch.
The column at which numeric totals are right-aligned in the summary section.
Padding width for plain (non-parenthesized) count prefixes in the summary. Leaves one character for the digit itself, aligning it at [constant _SUMMARY_COLUMN].
Padding width for parenthesized count prefixes in the summary. Accounts for the two extra characters in "(N)", aligning the digit at [constant _SUMMARY_COLUMN].
Label padding width for tree entries in [method _print_summary_tree_line]. The branch glyph (2 chars) and trailing space (1 char) account for the remaining columns.
Padding width for the severity label column in [method _print_message_tree]. [constant _SEVERITY_LABEL_WARNING_AS_ERROR] is the longest possible label (13 chars); padded to 14 for a trailing space.
Padding width for the label argument in [method _print_count_line].
Titles printed in the report section headers.
Labels for the section headings printed next to the pass/fail icon.
Severity label used when a warning is promoted to an error. This is also the longest possible label, which drives [constant _SEVERITY_LABEL_WIDTH].
Inline messages used during validation rendering.
Labels for the validation result line.
Labels for the items and messages totals trees in the summary section.
